description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aandaragasyaya, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830087
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details), with multiple schedules listing land particulars, extents, and ownership status. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
